title: fix(spec): the retired connector.webhooks refusal prescribes the declared-webhook model
body:
domain:spec#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzgbJhFoXYsLSe5WSPP

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB5CGwFpmZc621vVaShTPStz)_

Fixes #27448

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

**Prose only.** The refusal, its code, its path and the accept set do not move. Measured on the compile repro below: before and after, `objectstack compile` exits 2 with one issue, `code: invalid_type`, `expected: never`, `path: ["webhooks"]`. Only the `message` text changes.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:连接器上已退役的 `webhooks` 键被拒收时,处方原说「顶层 `webhooks:` 会物化进 `sys_webhook`」,现改为 ADR-0131 D2 的真实模型:平台从元数据注册表读取声明的 webhook 并在记录事件上投递,不写 `sys_webhook` 行。
- **为什么改**:作者照旧文案去找一条永远不会出现的 `sys_webhook` 行;实测声明的 webhook 写入 0 行。
- **风险与回滚**:纯文案,拒收本身、错误码、路径与可接受集不变;回滚即还原本 PR。
- **先看**:`packages/spec/src/integration/connector.zod.ts` 的 `WEBHOOKS_RETIRED`;`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.connector-resilience-keys-retired.ts` 的 `replacement` / `reason`;新 pin 在 `connector-resilience-keys-retirement.test.ts`。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/integration/connector-resilience-keys-retirement.test.ts`,预期 22/22 通过,其中一条断言新处方含「reads a declared webhook from the metadata registry」且不含「materialized」。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **The refusal.** `WEBHOOKS_RETIRED` (the `connector.webhooks` tombstone's prescription) now says the stack's top-level `webhooks:` collection is read from the metadata registry and delivered on record events, writes no `sys_webhook` row, and that `sys_webhook` holds only the webhooks an organization authors at runtime. It also drops "never materialized into `sys_webhook`" from the account of why a nested webhook never ran: the dispatcher never read it.
- **The D3 entry** `connector-resilience-keys-retired`: `replacement` says the top-level collection is read from the metadata registry and writes no `sys_webhook` row; `reason` says a nested webhook was never registered as a `webhook` item, read by the webhook dispatcher or delivered (was "registered, materialized or delivered").
- **The protocol-18 rationale fragment** for the same family in `migrations/registry.ts.template` (the upgrade text `os migrate` and the generated upgrade guide project): the same correction.
- **Generated reference.** `content/docs/references/integration/connector.mdx`, both `webhooks` rows, regenerated by `gen:docs` from the new `.describe()` (never by hand).
- **Comments carrying the same sentence:** the `webhooks` JSDoc on `ConnectorBaseSchema` (ships in `dist/*.d.ts`), two section comments in `connector.zod.ts`, the conversion docblock in `conversions/registry.ts`, and the retired-key and retired-def entry files for this retirement.
- **The liveness proof summary.** `packages/spec/scripts/liveness/proof-registry.mts`, row `webhook-materialization`: the summary said "a stack/connector-authored webhook is materialized into a dispatchable sys_webhook row on boot"; it now states what its proof (`packages/qa/dogfood/test/webhook-materialization.dogfood.test.ts`) pins: a webhook declared in the top-level `webhooks:` collection is dispatched from the metadata registry and writes no sys_webhook row, through the `declaredWebhooks` reader the plugin binds on the data engine alone, with `object`→`object_name` applied, on a boot without realtime. The comment beside its bindings says the same. `id`, `label`, `proofId`, `proofRef`, `bound` and `ledgerBindings` are unchanged.
- A `patch` changeset for `@objectstack/spec`.

Not touched: released `CHANGELOG.md` entries and `content/docs/releases/**` (release-owned). No hit in `skills/**` or `docs/adr/**` for the old sentence or its kin.

### The message, before and after

<details><summary>Before (origin/main 273137d2)</summary>

```text
`connector.webhooks` was removed in @objectstack/spec 17 (ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove) — a webhook nested inside a connector was never registered as a `webhook` item, so it was never materialized into `sys_webhook` and never delivered, and nothing emits the connector events its `events` list could name (`sync.completed`, `auth.expired` and the rest). Delete the key; the nested shape leaves with it (`WebhookConfig`, `WebhookEvent`, `WebhookSignatureAlgorithm`). To have a webhook actually sent, declare it in the stack's top-level `webhooks:` collection, which is materialized into `sys_webhook` and delivered on record events — note that doing so STARTS deliveries this connector never made. Run `os migrate meta --from 17` to list the mechanical edits for existing sources; `--write` applies the ones it can prove, and you apply the rest by hand.
```

</details>

<details><summary>After (this branch)</summary>

```text
`connector.webhooks` was removed in @objectstack/spec 17 (ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove) — a webhook nested inside a connector was never registered as a `webhook` item, so the webhook dispatcher never read it and never delivered it, and nothing emits the connector events its `events` list could name (`sync.completed`, `auth.expired` and the rest). Delete the key; the nested shape leaves with it (`WebhookConfig`, `WebhookEvent`, `WebhookSignatureAlgorithm`). To have a webhook actually sent, declare it in the stack's top-level `webhooks:` collection. The platform reads a declared webhook from the metadata registry and delivers it on record events; it writes no `sys_webhook` row for it (`sys_webhook` holds only the webhooks an organization authors at runtime). Note that declaring it STARTS deliveries this connector never made. Run `os migrate meta --from 17` to list the mechanical edits for existing sources; `--write` applies the ones it can prove, and you apply the rest by hand.
```

</details>

## Tests

- New pin in `packages/spec/src/integration/connector-resilience-keys-retirement.test.ts`: the `webhooks` refusal contains `reads a declared webhook from the metadata registry` and `it writes no \`sys_webhook\` row for it`, and matches neither `materialized into \`sys_webhook\`` nor `materiali[sz]`; the D3 entry's `replacement` contains `reads from the metadata registry` and `writes no \`sys_webhook\` row`, and neither `replacement` nor `reason` says `materiali[sz]`. The existing pins (path, `invalid_type`, the opening sentence, `top-level \`webhooks:\` collection`, the migrate sentence, no tracker number) are unchanged and still green.
- Round 1, at head `4ec164b9` (liveness summary), under `os-verify-lock`: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:liveness` green (`✓ … every governed-type property … is classified`, state counts current: 1219 classified); the liveness script tests `vitest run scripts/liveness/` **12/12 files, 358/358**; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test:repo` **86/86 files, 1420/1420**.
- Round 0, at head `80e34d7f`, all under `os-verify-lock` (shared-box seconds):
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test` (local project): **750/750 files, 22313 passed, 1 todo**.
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test:repo` (the repo project, which holds `connector-resilience-keys-retirement.test.ts`): **86/86 files, 1420/1420 tests**.
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: exit 0 (`check:test-typecheck: OK`).
- **Reverse check of the new pin (one-off, no file left).** With `connector.zod.ts` reset to `origin/main`'s bytes (old sentence present: 1 hit; new phrase: 0 hits), the retirement test file reads **1 failed | 21 passed (22)**: `AssertionError: expected '\`connector.webhooks\` was removed in @…' to contain 'reads a declared webhook from the met…'`. Restored with `git checkout HEAD -- packages/spec/src/integration/connector.zod.ts`; `git diff HEAD` empty and the blob hash matches HEAD.

## Acceptance notes

- **Liveness proof prose is in scope (seat, round 1).** The `webhook-materialization` proof summary carried the same false sentence; corrected here (see What changes). Its proof already asserted ADR-0131 D2, so only text moved.
- **Governed surfaces.** No hit for the old sentence or its kin in `skills/**` or `docs/adr/**`, so none is named.
- Released `CHANGELOG.md` entries (`@objectstack/spec` and five connector/automation packages) still carry the original retirement note's "never materialized into `sys_webhook`". That clause is about the nested array and was true of the model when it shipped; release-owned text, not edited.

## Verification

<details><summary>Measure first, on origin/main 273137d2</summary>

- **Compile refusal reproduced.** Scratch copy of `examples/app-showcase` (removed afterwards), `webhooks: [{url:'http://x/c', events:['create']}] as any` added to `showcase_status_api`, `npx objectstack compile`: **exit 2**, one issue `{"expected":"never","code":"invalid_type","path":["webhooks"]}` with the "Before" message above (quoted verbatim from that run). Same copy against this branch's rebuilt spec: **exit 2**, the same `expected`, `code` and `path`, the "After" message.
- **A declared webhook writes no `sys_webhook` row, on the code path.** `packages/plugins/plugin-webhooks/src/declared-webhooks.ts` reads declared webhooks from `engine._registry.listItems('webhook')` (falling back to the kernel `metadata` service) on every cache refresh; no `sys_webhook` insert exists outside tests. Its pin `declared-webhooks.test.ts` › "nothing writes a sys_webhook row: the plugin boot binds the reader and seeds zero rows" (`engine.writes.filter((w) => w.object === 'sys_webhook')` equals `[]`): **1 passed | 21 skipped**, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.

</details>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `4ec164b9`: 107 derived (round 0's 105 plus `check:pm-governed-merges` and `check:pnpm-flag-spellings`). Reconciled with `--ran`: **107 accounted, 105 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN** (`✓ dispatch-gates --ran`). The two exit 3 are prerequisite misses that need a full repo build (`spec check:skill-examples`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`), not findings; CI's check-runs carry them.
